title: The Incredible Hulk Returns
edition: 1988 live-action television reunion with Bill Bixby and Lou Ferrigno; Thor is the warrior summoned by Donald Blake.
synopsis: David is close to a cure when his former student brings a mysterious hammer into his laboratory. Maggie’s abductors want the device David hoped would heal him.
verdictRationale: Giving up a chance at a cure so that Maggie can come home is David’s most admirable decision. The picture also makes a spectacle of the very power he has spent years trying to control. Its strongest invitation to compassion comes late, after an extended contest of strength.
ageRationale: Maggie is held to force an exchange. A child may find the separation and the Hulk’s physical changes more unsettling than the brief blows. Thor’s drinking is played as barroom entertainment.
reflection: David hopes for a quiet life with Maggie. When her safety depends on the machine meant to restore that life, he discovers which part of his hope he can surrender.

themes.name: Sacrificial care
themes.evidence: David puts Maggie’s rescue ahead of his chance to use the transponder. The choice redirects the final act.

themes.name: Cooperation
themes.evidence: Thor and Hulk initially clash and later combine their strength in the rescue. Their change matters most near the end.

themes.name: Coercion
themes.evidence: The kidnappers use Maggie as the price of obtaining David’s invention. Her captivity drives the rescue.

title: The Trial of the Incredible Hulk
edition: 1989 live-action Bill Bixby television feature with Rex Smith as Matt Murdock.
synopsis: David intervenes when two men assault Ellie on a train. After he is accused of the attack, Matt Murdock takes his case and tries to learn why Ellie fears telling the truth.
verdictRationale: David’s first intervention costs him his freedom. Matt offers legal help to a man who cannot pay him, and later needs David to save him when Fisk exploits his sensitive hearing. Each man gets a turn at being vulnerable. Ellie’s fear for her parents gives her false account a human context and makes witness protection a moral issue.
ageRationale: The train assault carries a sexual threat. Fisk also threatens Ellie’s family, and Matt is deliberately disoriented and severely beaten. The danger to a witness and the targeting of a disability warrant discussion with teens.
reflection: When Ellie changes her story, the question becomes who will keep her parents safe. Asking a frightened witness to be brave creates an obligation for the people who hear her.

themes.name: Protection of the vulnerable
themes.evidence: David steps in on the train and later saves Matt from Fisk’s men. Two costly interventions frame the partnership.

themes.name: Service
themes.evidence: Matt offers representation despite David’s inability to pay and continues investigating Ellie’s account. His help sustains the case.

themes.name: Intimidation
themes.evidence: Threats against Ellie’s parents silence her. Fisk then has her abducted when she offers to speak. Coercion drives the investigation.

title: The Death of the Incredible Hulk
edition: 1990 live-action television finale with Bill Bixby as David and Lou Ferrigno as Hulk.
synopsis: David and Jasmine have a chance to flee together. Learning that the Pratts are captives, they go to the airfield to help them instead.
verdictRationale: The decision to turn back gives the finale its moral weight. David first helps the Pratts escape and then runs toward a plane threatening Jasmine. His death leaves people who loved him grieving. Families can admire the care that took him there and allow that loss to hurt.
ageRationale: Gunfire, a plane explosion and David’s fatal fall lead to a sustained farewell. Younger viewers attached to the television hero may find his death in human form especially distressing.
reflection: David tends Jasmine’s wound when he has reason to distrust her. Long before his last rescue, this ordinary act of mercy lets two people accustomed to hiding begin to trust each other.

themes.name: Self-sacrifice
themes.evidence: David gives up escape to help the Pratts and takes a fatal risk protecting Jasmine. The climax gives these choices lasting consequences.

themes.name: Mercy
themes.evidence: David treats Jasmine’s wound after her involvement with the spies. A short private act of care changes their relationship.

themes.name: Manipulation
themes.evidence: Bella’s supposed captivity is a deception that exploits Jasmine’s loyalty. Its discovery breaks her allegiance to the network.
